canada.title: Aging water infrastructure is stalling housing construction throughout Quebec
canada.summary: Most of Quebec's water and sewer infrastructure was built between 1950 and 1990, and now much of it is reaching the end of its lifespan. Treatment plants across the province are barely limping along, while sewer pipes are reaching their half-life limit.

canada.title: 'Nobody was expecting an evacuation': seniors’ centre in Châteauguay, Que., closed abruptly
canada.summary: On Monday, the City of Châteauguay issued a notice that two municipal buildings would be closed. One building, which houses the community radio station and TV station, would be demolished. The other, the seniors' centre next door, would be closed temporarily for a minimum of three months, while engineers check the structural aspects to see if it also needs to be demolished.
